clue.text: He disparages thespian after adventure (oddly suppressed)

indicators.note: after places the actor's letters behind the letters taken from adventure
with the odd-placed letters of the word adventure put down, only its even-placed letters remain

parts.note: a thespian is a stage performer, an actor

explanation.surface: A man running down an actor who followed some escapade, with the strange parts hushed up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'oddly suppressed' looks like a description of the adventure's hushed-up details, but it means keeping only the even-placed letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who belittles or runs down others is a critic of this kind, so 'he disparages' describes such a person.

clue.text: Allowed to enter river to get wipe

indicators.note: to enter asks for the allowed word to go into the river's letters

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Scotland and another in Wales/England
allowed means let, as in permitted

explanation.surface: Someone is allowed into a river in order to get cleaned off.
explanation.definitionFit: To wipe a file or recording is to erase it, a direct synonym.

clue.text: I had featured in short talk relating to sea level changes

indicators.note: featured in says the I-had letters appear inside the shortened talk
short says the word talk loses its final letter

parts.note: I had contracts to I'd

explanation.surface: A speaker had a slot in a brief lecture on how the sea rises and falls.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short' loses the final letter of the talk word, and 'featured in' places the contracted I had inside what remains.
explanation.definitionFit: Tides are the regular rise and fall of the sea, so anything relating to them is described by this adjective.

clue.text: Opening answer cheeky — you're listening

parts.note: cheeky means pert, impudent

indicators.note: listening tells us to take the sound of the word you're rather than its spelling

parts.note: you're is said much like the ending URE

explanation.surface: A cheeky reply opens a remark addressed to someone who is paying attention.
explanation.definitionFit: An aperture is a gap or hole, such as the opening in a camera lens that lets light through.

clue.text: Practical method riled narrator, struggling

indicators.note: struggling suggests the letters of riled narrator in disorder

explanation.surface: An irritated storyteller is having difficulty.
explanation.definitionFit: Trying things and learning from failures is a hands-on, empirical way of solving problems.

clue.text: Impetuous when embraced by Royal Highness

indicators.note: embraced by puts the when-word inside the royal abbreviation

parts.note: RH is the abbreviation for Royal Highness
as can mean when, as in 'as he arrived'

explanation.surface: Someone acts hastily on being hugged by a royal.
explanation.definitionFit: Hasty and reckless behaviour is impetuous; both words mean acting without thought.

clue.text: Drink is withdrawn: pressure to follow

indicators.note: to follow puts the pressure letter after the reversed word
withdrawn means the word is goes back, read in reverse

parts.note: P is the physics symbol for pressure

explanation.surface: A drink has been taken off the market, with pressure to come.
explanation.definitionFit: A sip is a small mouthful, and to sip is to drink in small amounts.

clue.text: Quiet nieces dancing left inside

indicators.note: inside places the left letter within the rearranged nieces
dancing sets the letters of nieces moving into a new order

explanation.surface: Some nieces dance quietly, having been left indoors.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dancing' turns NIECES into SIENCE, and 'inside' puts L within it.
explanation.definitionFit: Quiet as a noun is an absence of noise, which is a synonym.

clue.text: Rave, say, about island equalness?

indicators.note: about says the party word goes around the island letter

parts.note: a rave is an example of a party, hence 'say'

explanation.surface: A dance party is held concerning fairness on an island.
explanation.definitionFit: Being equal in status or value is the state of parity, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Guy with large English spoon

parts.note: a guy is a lad, a young man
L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large

explanation.surface: A man carries a big English spoon.
explanation.definitionFit: A ladle is a large deep-bowled serving spoon for soup, a specific example.

clue.text: Narrow-minded barb cut short by a Queen

indicators.note: cut short says the word for a barb loses its final letter

parts.note: a barb is a cutting remark, an insult
R, for Regina, is the abbreviation for queen

explanation.surface: A bigot's jibe is interrupted by the monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: Insular literally means island-like; figuratively it describes an outlook cut off from wider ideas, so a bigoted one.

clue.text: Legendary Swiss patriot thanks the French for revealing source

parts.note: William Tell is the legendary Swiss hero who shot an apple from his son's head
ta is informal British for thanks
le is French for the

explanation.surface: Thanking the folk hero of Switzerland, in French.
explanation.definitionFit: A telltale is a person or sign that gives away information, a source of revelation.

clue.text: We're told something other than nautical speed

indicators.note: we're told signals that the word is heard, so a word spelt differently but sounding the same is meant

parts.note: not means something other than, as in 'red, not blue'

explanation.surface: We are informed of a speed that is not the nautical kind.
explanation.definitionFit: Ships' speeds are measured in units of one sea mile per hour.

clue.text: Similar to competent — pleasing

parts.note: like means similar to
competent means able

explanation.surface: Being similar to a capable person is agreeable.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone pleasing is agreeable and easy to warm to, a synonym.

clue.text: Downloadable program, ultimately clever, attracts beginners

parts.note: an app is a program downloaded to a phone or computer

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of clever

parts.note: attracts means entices, lures

explanation.surface: A clever piece of software appeals to novices.
explanation.definitionFit: Apprentices are learners starting out in a trade, so they are novices or beginners.

clue.text: Traveller not finishing medicine, unpleasant

indicators.note: not finishing says the word for medicine loses its last letter

parts.note: a pill is a dose of medicine
grim means unpleasant, dismal

explanation.surface: A traveller fails to complete a nasty course of medicine.
explanation.definitionFit: A pilgrim journeys to a holy place, a particular kind of traveller.

clue.text: Malfunction disheartened girl with restless desire

indicators.note: disheartened removes the heart, the central letters, of the word girl

parts.note: an itch is a restless craving

explanation.surface: A dejected girl suffers a malfunction and a restless longing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disheartened' takes IR from the middle of GIRL, leaving GL.
explanation.definitionFit: A glitch is a sudden minor fault, especially in machinery or software.

clue.text: Parking. manipulated steel tool

parts.note: P is the road-sign abbreviation for parking

indicators.note: manipulated says the letters of steel are worked into another order

explanation.surface: A parking device made of worked steel.
explanation.definitionFit: A pestle is the club-shaped implement used with a mortar for grinding.

clue.text: Returning some tell oldster to relax

indicators.note: Returning says the hidden letters are read backwards
some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: On coming back, one tells an old person to take it easy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'some' picks LLOL from 'teLL OLdster', and 'Returning' reverses it.
explanation.definitionFit: To loll is to lounge or sprawl lazily, a way of relaxing.

clue.text: Be like part of Empire's emblem

indicators.note: part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Something looks like a piece of an imperial badge.
explanation.definitionFit: To be like something is to look similar to it, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Well done finding codeword!

definitions.meaning: a cry of approval for a performance
the NATO phonetic alphabet word for the letter B

explanation.surface: Congratulations on discovering a secret password.
explanation.definitionFit: It is both a shout of applause and the radio code word for B.

clue.text: Secure time for drink of beer

parts.note: to pin is to secure or fasten

explanation.surface: Arrange a time to go for a beer.
explanation.definitionFit: Beer in Britain is served by the pint, so a pint is a glass of it.

clue.text: Row about stray dog

indicators.note: about puts the row word around the stray word

parts.note: a tier is a row, as of seats
to err is to stray from the right path

explanation.surface: An argument breaks out over a stray dog.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Row' looks like an argument (rhyming with cow) but is a line of seats, TIER.
explanation.definitionFit: A terrier is a breed type of small, lively dog, so an example of the definition.

clue.text: Criticise Bishop in the end

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
at last means in the end, finally

explanation.surface: Eventually someone attacks a bishop.
explanation.definitionFit: To blast someone is to criticise them fiercely, a figurative synonym.

clue.text: Henry in the morning delivers meat

parts.note: H is the symbol for the henry, the unit of inductance
am stands for ante meridiem, before noon

explanation.surface: Henry brings round meat each morning.
explanation.definitionFit: Ham is cured pork from the pig's thigh, an example of meat.

clue.text: Group meets hero unexpectedly

indicators.note: unexpectedly signals the letters of meets hero falling into a surprising new order

explanation.surface: A group runs into a hero by surprise.
explanation.definitionFit: A trio, a set of three, is a small group.
